notes: CommCare HQ (Dimagi) publishes no machine-readable API description — the Data API is Tastypie plus hand-written Django views, and a full clone of dimagi/commcare-hq contains no openapi/swagger file (see attempts[]). This spec was authored from the vendor's own API reference (the 27 pages of commcare-hq.readthedocs.io/api, mirrored as docs/api/*.rst) and cross-checked against CommCare's URL routing in corehq/apps/api/urls.py, which is what made it possible to enumerate resources the prose does not name. 'Full' means every endpoint the vendor documents, plus the resources its router registers: 137 paths / 181 operations covering cases (Data API v1 and v2), forms and attachments, applications, mobile workers, web users, invitations, groups, locations (v1 and v2) and location types, lookup tables and fixtures, configurable reports, UCR data and data sources, DET exports, OData feeds, messaging events, device logs, project-space metadata, the navigation audit log, the OpenRosa form receiver and OTA restore, the case and lookup-table spreadsheet uploads, and the two account-level endpoints (identity, user_domains). CommCare versions resources individually, so each resource is modelled at BOTH URLs it is served at — the current `/a/{domain}/api/<resource>/v1/` and the legacy `/a/{domain}/api/v0.5/<resource>/` (or v0.6/v2) that CommCare still serves and that the OpenFn adaptor pins — which is why the operation count is roughly double the resource count. Caveats: (1) best-effort because it is docs-derived — field sets come from the documented example responses and are representative, not exhaustive, and every resource schema therefore allows additional properties; (2) the form receiver and OTA restore really return OpenRosa XML and are declared as text/xml, and case/form attachments as binary, so those operations have no JSON response schema; (3) Tastypie's `{meta, objects}` envelope is used for every Tastypie list even where an old docs page (cases-v1, list-reports) still shows a bare array — the live API and the mock both send the envelope; (4) the superseded v0.3/v0.4 aliases of the Data API are still registered by CommCare but are not modelled here except for `product`, which is only served at v0.3; (5) the admin-only accounting resources (billing, subscriptions, invoices) under ADMIN_API_LIST are deliberately out of scope — they are not part of the project-space API and are not documented for integrators.
